name: kepler.gl
description: Build kepler.gl maps from a CSV, Parquet, GeoJSON or shapefile, render them as local pages you can edit and save, and — when you sign in — upload them to a server that keeps the map config and the data as Parquet.

interface.longDescription: Turn a CSV, Parquet file, GeoJSON file or shapefile into an interactive kepler.gl map, written as a page you can open, edit and save. Layers, colour ramps and tooltips are chosen from the data that was actually loaded, so a map opens with something drawn rather than with an empty basemap. Signing in is optional and only needed to upload a map to the kepler.gl server, where projects group maps and every map's config and data are stored as Parquet.
defaultPrompt: Map the earthquakes in this CSV by magnitude
Turn this GeoJSON of counties into a choropleth of unemployment
Upload my local maps to a project on the kepler.gl server
